meta.title: Status line
meta.description: Adds one line at the bottom of the window with the active session's git state: branch (or short commit when detached), worktree, working directory, counts of modified, added, untracked and deleted files, and ahead/behind. It refreshes every three seconds with read-only git commands and shows "not a git repository" outside a repository, or "git not found" when git is missing. Requires git on PATH.
